Class.summary: Controller responsible for retrieving system-wide dashboard metrics and analytics. Restricted exclusively to administrators.

Constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class.
Constructor.param: The service used to obtain the current authenticated user's ID and role.

GetStats.summary: Retrieves system-wide ticket counts and key performance indicators.
GetStats.remarks: Returns ticket counts grouped by state (Open, InProgress, Resolved, Closed, CriticalOpen) as well as the overall average resolution time in hours.
GetStats.response: If the user is not authenticated.
If the user is not an administrator.

GetAgentWorkload.summary: Retrieves the current workload and open ticket distribution across all support agents.
GetAgentWorkload.remarks: Used by administrators to monitor agent capacity, open ticket volume, and logged work minutes.
GetAgentWorkload.returns: A list of agent workload metrics.
GetAgentWorkload.response: If the user is not authenticated.
If the user is not an administrator.

GetTicketTrends.summary: Retrieves daily ticket creation and closure trend metrics over a specified lookback period.
GetTicketTrends.param: The number of days to analyze (must be between 1 and 365, default is 30).
GetTicketTrends.returns: A chronological list of daily open and closed ticket counts.
GetTicketTrends.response: Returns the daily ticket trend metrics.
If the days parameter is less than 1 or greater than 365.
If the user is not authenticated.
If the user is not an administrator.
